verdict.rationale: Meltano can be driven programmatically through a well-documented, scriptable CLI (init, add, config, run), with idempotent commands and a declarative meltano.yml project file that agents can automate. However, there is no evidence of a public HTTP or programmatic API: the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented public REST or programmatic API, an OpenAPI spec, and SDK-level control of pipelines beyond the CLI.
